# Mapfix

Mapfix is a Ukrainian local services map: find nearby tradespeople (plumber, electrician, home repair, auto service, beauty) in Kyiv and call them directly. No marketplace commission.

- Site: https://mapfix-wine.vercel.app/
- Language: Ukrainian (uk)
- Primary city: Kyiv
- For customers: open the map, pick a category or district, call or request a job.
- For businesses: claim an existing listing in about a minute by entering the phone number on the card. Adding a business is free.

Useful URLs:
- https://mapfix-wine.vercel.app/kyiv/home — plumber / home repair
- https://mapfix-wine.vercel.app/kyiv/home/plumber — plumber in Kyiv
- https://mapfix-wine.vercel.app/kyiv/home/electrician — electrician in Kyiv
- https://mapfix-wine.vercel.app/kyiv/auto/tyres — tire service
- https://mapfix-wine.vercel.app/kyiv/borshchahivka — Borshchahivka district
- https://mapfix-wine.vercel.app/kyiv/kotsiubynske — Kotsiubynske
- https://mapfix-wine.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
